title: Financial Assistance Program Terms: Installment Pauses and Hardship Review under the Patient Payment Plans
content:
Under the Patient Payment Plans, installment pauses and a scheduled review of terms are features of the Financial Hardship Plan only. The following terms state the pause and review figures of every tier.

| Tier | Installments may be paused | Longest single pause (months) | Maximum pauses over the plan's life | Review of terms, calendar months after signing (0 means no review) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 3-Month Interest-Free Plan | No | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| 6-Month Interest-Free Plan | No | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| 12-Month Interest-Free Plan | No | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| 18-Month Extended Plan | No | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| 24-Month Extended Plan | No | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Financial Hardship Plan | Yes | 3 | 1 | 12 |

Terms:

1. On the Financial Hardship Plan installments may be paused for a single pause of up to 3 months, and at most 1 time over the plan's life.
2. On the Financial Hardship Plan the terms are reviewed 12 calendar months after signing.
3. On every other tier installments may not be paused, and no review of terms is scheduled.
